rationale: Executing the last open producer check for the asserted snapshot-trigger defect: whether the snapshot-install path leaves a follower with an emptied log store below its snapshot index. The harness runs a two-node cluster with TrailingLogs=0, applies an entry, takes a snapshot on the leader (compacting everything up to it), applies one more entry, then merges a fresh unbootstrapped node and adds it as a voter, waiting for that node's snapshot index to become non-zero before sampling its log store last index, snapshot index, applied index, commit index and shouldSnapshot. Native construction feedback with these fixed inputs showed the fresh node DID install a snapshot (installed_index=3) and yet store_last=5 against snapshot_index=3, so store_emptied was false and should_snapshot stayed false: the AddVoter configuration entry and the following replication refilled the log above the installed snapshot before the sample. That is a negative for this route as constructed, and it also shows the discriminator must quiesce the leader after the install (for example add the node first, then disconnect it, apply and snapshot on the leader, and reconnect) for the emptied state to be observable. This submission records the experiment for controller execution; the measured interpretation is left for the retained receipt.

scope.description: One process, two real raft instances bootstrapped over InmemTransport with TrailingLogs=0 plus a third fresh unbootstrapped instance merged into the same transport set. The leader applies one command, takes a user snapshot (compacting its log), applies a second command, then adds the fresh node with AddVoter and waits up to five seconds for that node's cached snapshot index to become non-zero. The fresh node's log store last index, snapshot index, applied index, commit index, store_emptied and shouldSnapshot are then recorded, together with the leader's prepared snapshot index and the AddVoter result.

experiment.prefix: MakeCluster(2, t, conf) with conf.TrailingLogs=0 gives two real Voters over InmemTransport with InmemStore logs and stable state, and waits for a leader; MakeClusterNoBootstrap(1, t, nil) creates the third instance with an empty log and no configuration; Merge plus FullyConnect wire all three transports so the fresh node is reachable. The leader's own snapshot path (Raft.Snapshot -> takeSnapshot -> compactLogs) removes the logs up to the snapshot index, so the fresh node cannot be caught up by log entries alone and the leader must ship a snapshot; the harness waits for the target's snapshot index rather than for a fixed delay so the sample is taken after the install actually happened. No production logic is modified; all observations are package-internal reads of the runtime objects.
